I’ll need to check out of the hotel by 12:00 PM, and I’m planning to use a rideshare to get to the airport. I want to leave myself 2 hours 15 minutes for transit, baggage drop, and security. My preferred return window is 1:30 PM to 4:30 PM, and I want to figure out which departure time best fits a same-day checkout without feeling rushed.

items.user_turn: Can you help me pack for New York in winter? I’ll be there December 20 to December 27, and I expect to be outside walking for about 30 to 60 minutes at a time, so I want to be ready for that cold without overpacking. I only have one carry-on suitcase plus one personal item, and I’d rather bring warm layers I can mix and match than a bunch of bulky extras.
items.task_goal: plan weather-aware packing for a New York winter visit, with a compact checklist that fits the trip and bag constraints
